citations.title: Research Statement Languages, Compilers, and Tools for Multicore Architectures

reception: Outside the group the citation record is modest and stays close to stream compilation. The most engaged use is in mobile sensing, where work on static memory management builds on the schedules and a follow-on line adopts the ideas; scheduling papers such as the buffer-space efficient, deadlock-free work of Park and Dally cite its results as evidence about the code-size and buffer-space tradeoff. Evaluations of other stream systems reuse its benchmarks, and most remaining citations are brief mentions situating new schedulers against StreamIt. It is a paper cited within one community — mostly as background, occasionally as a foundation.
